name: Joshikou Seifuku Monogatari
source:
Hero is attending preparatory school for a year. He lives alone and has to earn a living at part time jobs. If he still has time, he can pursue love interests for girls in the neighborhood. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-november-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在補習班準備了一整年的考試。他獨自生活，必須靠打工維生。如果還有空閒，他也可以追求住在附近的女孩。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-november-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
